lessons.title: Family
explanation: **gesin** = your household (parents and children). **familie** = your wider family/relatives.
**ouma** and **oupa** (granny, grandpa) are used everywhere in South Africa, even in English!

examples.af: Ek het twee broers en een suster.
examples.en: I have two brothers and one sister.
My granny lives on a farm.

answers: My granny lives on a farm.
My grandmother lives on a farm.
My gran lives on a farm.

lessons.title: Food and the braai
explanation: **lekker** is the most useful word in Afrikaans: tasty, nice, great. **Die kos is lekker!**
A **braai** is a South African barbecue, and a huge part of social life. You'll eat **vleis** (meat), **boerewors** (spiced sausage), and maybe **pap** (maize porridge).
**Ek is honger** = I'm hungry. **Ek is dors** = I'm thirsty.

examples.en: We're having a braai on Saturday.

exercises.en: We're having a braai on Saturday.

exercises.af: Ek is ___. Mag ek water kry?
exercises.en: I'm thirsty. May I have water?

lessons.title: At home
explanation: Rooms of the house. **in die kombuis** = in the kitchen.

exercises.en: The dog is in the garden.
exercises.af: Die hond is in die tuin.
